message: 死亡フラグ回避

name: Synn
message: 「...And that's what happened.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry... We didn't know anything about it...」

name: Ria
message: 「No, it couldn't be helped. We really should've called everyone too, but we didn't even have the leeway for that...」

name: Misa
message: 「Bylous showed up as well. And Sengen'in-sensei turned out to be a demon named Soltia.」

name: Sally
message: 「Speaking of Soltia, she's one of the Seven Demon Generals.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Really!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. I don't really know what kind of person she is, though. Still, I hear both of them are super strong.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are they stronger than you, Miss Tag-along?」

name: Sally
message: 「Obviously I'm way stronger!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then they're no big deal.」

name: Sally
message: 「What did you say--!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't talk stupid. Their strength isn't even comparable to Flat-chest's boss, let alone Pasta.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So he says.」

name: Sally
message: 「I wasn't even brought up for comparison!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun. Is what Paqy-san is saying true?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... They were strong. Really strong.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And you two were actually okay taking them on by yourselves...?」

name: Synn
message: 「In the end, we were okay... though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with that half-hearted way of putting it?」

name: Ria
message: 「...Synn-kun saved me!! That's why we both made it out safe!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President took on opponents that strong!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Way to go, Synn!!」

name: Misa
message: 「As expected of my rival.」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, I'm still stronger though--」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not a lie, right?\s07」
Still, we only escaped a tight spot--nothing has actually been resolved. If they attack us again...

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, um... I really don't understand what Bylous-san and Soltia-san are after at all.」

name: Ria
message: 「The one thing we do know is that neither Bylous nor Soltia is on our side.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But Bylous let us get away, didn't he?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... Plus, those two didn't seem to be on very good terms.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That makes it even harder to understand~~」

name: Sally
message: 「All demons are pretty careless like that.」
I feel like it's a bit unfair to compare them to Sally-chan.

name: Helena
message: 「Good morning, members of the Student Council.」
Her words are the same as usual, yet her tone is unusually serious.

name: Helena
message: 「Today, Sengen'in-sensei resigned.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Helena
message: 「She... really was a Demon after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「You knew!?」

name: Helena
message: 「I had no concrete proof, so I couldn't confide in you... though I thought it would be best to let her roam free for a while.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think she realized what you were doing?」

name: Helena
message: 「Probably. Still, it was convenient for her too. If she wanted to do 'something' at the academy without causing a commotion... right?」

name: Helena
message: 「However, I never imagined she would reveal her true identity right in front of you all...」

name: Helena
message: 「And because of that, I put you all in danger... I'm truly sorry.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big sis...」

name: Helena
message: 「The foremost among the Seven Demon Generals have begun showing themselves... Not only Soltia, but even Bylous.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There won't be some twist like there were actually eight of them all along, right?!」

name: Helena
message: 「I wonder... There's no guarantee that the Seven Demon Generals are our only enemies.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean by that?」

name: Helena
message: 「I mean there might be other shady characters out there trying to take advantage of Re-Crea to pull something off.」

name: Helena
message: 「Aah~ If only the Demon Lord were around at a time like this~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-N-No way!! If even the Demon Lord were to show up...」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though we already have our hands full with the Seven Demon Generals...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A third faction out of nowhere right now?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, knock it off with the bad jokes!!」

name: Helena
message: 「No~body ever said the Demon Lord was an enemy, did they? Well, I don't know if he'd be an ally either, though... right, Ria?」

name: Ria
message: 「Wh-Why are you asking me...」

name: Helena
message: 「Because whenever the Demon Lord comes up, you're always so desperate to defend him.」

name: Ria
message: 「Urgh... ugh...」

name: Helena
message: 「And yet, you're not acting like yourself today. You aren't hiding something from me, are you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's not...」
Ria-senpai is shaken too...
Just as I thought, she hasn't told anyone that I'm the Demon Lord.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-What should we do?」

name: Misa
message: 「Who's behind this, and for what purpose... Why would they do something like this...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Honestly... I really don't want us to have any more enemies than we already do...」
Still, everyone is feeling anxious...
Should I just come clean and tell them the truth here...

name: Helena
message: 「Anyway. We can't just sit around spacing out like this. Alright.」

name: Helena
message: 「No matter what, we have no choice but to call in that helper!!」

name: Synn
message: 「A helper...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could it be the Demon Lord!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, that's a liiittle off, though there's no doubt they're someone we can count on.」

name: Helena
message: 「'I won't do you wrong. Leave the rest to me'」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, wait...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She took off...」

name: Misa
message: 「A helper... huh. Who could possibly show up at this late stage, I wonder.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Does anyone come to mind, Senpai?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ria-senpai...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh... Eeeh!?」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sorry... um... what were we talking about?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you okay, Senpai? Aren't you still exhausted?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's not true at all! Look, I'm totally full of energy♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Please don't push yourself too hard...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm not pushing myself at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Now, now\s02 Um... well then, for now, let's talk about what to do going forward...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What you'd call a strategy meeting, right!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Enemies on a completely different level from the demons we've fought up until now have appeared.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Which means if we don't figure out a way to beat them, we're the ones who'll get wiped out.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, haven't we already done tons of special training and stuff up until now?」

name: Ria
message: 「A way for us to get even stronger than this...」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine. As long as everyone's together.」

name: Synn
message: 「Back then, it was just me and Ria-senpai. As long as everyone's here, I'm sure we'll be fine. We'll figure something out, right, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah! You're right!」
There is no end to things to worry about, yet just being together with everyone feels reassuring.
If you lose confidence, you lose. Let's always stay positive!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Like in suspense stories, you know? There's always someone who immediately wants to split up when a crisis hits. That totally backfires.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is what is known as raising a death flag.」

name: Misa
message: 「Then for the time being, we're all in agreement that all of the Crusaders will act together?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, that sounds good.」

name: Misa
message: 「B-But, the bathroom is an exception!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I get it already.\s02」
